high_level_description: The image depicts a close-up view of a door with a decorative emblem in the center. The door is framed by two vertical red panels adorned with gold star-like designs at the bottom corners. The emblem in the center features a shield with a blue background and a white cross. Above the shield, there is a depiction of a papal tiara (three-tiered crown) and a set of keys, which are symbols commonly associated with the Pope and the Catholic Church.
